description: This file defines the PurgeableBitmap class, a sample Android activity demonstrating the behavior of purgeable bitmaps, including decoding bitstreams and tracking memory use with UI dialogs.

classes.name: PurgeableBitmap
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating purgeable bitmap behavior with UI alerts.

classes.name: RefreshHandler
classes.description: A Handler subclass managing UI updates and message handling for bitmap decoding progress.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, creates the view, and starts the redraw handler.

methods.name: detectIfPurgeableRequest
methods.description: Determines if the activity was launched with a 'Purgeable' request based on activity label metadata.

methods.name: getDialogMessage
methods.description: Generates a message string for dialogs indicating memory or decoding status.

methods.name: showAlertDialog
methods.description: Displays an alert dialog with a given message.
